scripts.build:local: node scripts/media.mjs --mode local && cross-env VILAX_MODE=local astro build
scripts.build:preview: node scripts/media.mjs --mode preview && cross-env VILAX_MODE=preview astro build
scripts.build:prod: node scripts/media.mjs --mode prod && cross-env VILAX_MODE=prod astro build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build:local && npm run test && npm run verify
